# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block

  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).

  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run

  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap

Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. - **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 31
- **Additions**: +4037
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T10:29:54Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. ## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)

- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).

- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1563
- **Title**: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)

- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`

- **Additions**: +4037

- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T10:29:54Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block

  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).

  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run

  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1563
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1563
- **Title**: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 31
- **Additions**: +4037
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T10:29:54Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…
