# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume
  (CLI `_loadSession`, app `loadSession`).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail; its report carries `notedOrphanKeys` — the wire frame is
  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);
  carriers `[{text:"[Image N]"},{image}]` anchor before the first
  referencing user message or after the tool-result run (never inside
  call/result pairs); the current user message rides images in place
  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap
  (`images.maxPerRequest`, default 20) drops current-first-then-newest
  with a drop notice (never silent; the app logs drops via `AppLog`,
  issue #195 F4); dangling refs (compaction, cap) resolve to `(image no
  longer available)`, and once a renumbering boundary exists (compaction
  summary, structured marker, local-trim note) AUTHORED history
  citations degrade to that note too — after renumbering an `[Image N]`
  may name a different image, so silent rebinding is never allowed
  (issue #195 F2; generated refs/labels stay content-keyed and fresh).
  Stateless per-request rebuild — determinism, compaction evictio…

If a malicious/corrupt foreign session file contains `blob:sha256:../../etc/something`, the adapter reads `$homeDir/.omp/agent/blobs/../../etc/something` — path traversal within the fs abstraction. The blobRef comes from the foreign file being imported (user's own store, read-only import of own data). Impact: a crafted session file could make the importer read arbitrary files readable by the process (and if the image decodes as base64, embed content into the FA session as an image block — data exfiltration into a shared session file? No — `hasMatch` without multiLine anchors `^`/`$` to whole string: `^...$` matches whole string (not multiline), so the entire file must be one base64-looking line. Realistically narrow, but path traversal should be blocked at the source: validate hash is hex/[A-Za-z0-9]. arguments.content:
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The architecture is sound (read-only adapters, pure mapper, injectable `ImportLimits`, zero provider wiring, trajectory-style CLI interception), and the lib layer analyzes clean — but this branch does not build or test as committed. Reviewed on a Linux runner with a working Dart SDK 3.13.5: `dart analyze` reports **47 errors in the new import files** (the other 79 analyzer errors are pre-existing `office_addin/` package issues untouched by this PR), and `dart test test/import ...` fails 5 ways: four test files fail to load (compile errors), and the machine-gated E2E test fails instead of skipping.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `bin/fah_import.dart` uses `ImportLimits` without a visible import — the whole `fa` CLI fails to compile.
- 🚨 `test/import_runner_test.dart` + `test/import_tui_test.dart` declare `String get ompRoot/ompBucket` **inside `void main()`** (local getters are invalid Dart — 41 cascading errors), plus positional-vs-named drift against the local `run` helper and `.path` on a `String` in `omp_adapter_test.dart` (helper returns the path, callers expect a `Directory`).
- 🚨 `import_mapper_test.dart` references `ToolResultMessage`, which lives in `lib/src/context.dart` and is not imported.
- 🚨 The E2E test calls `markTestSkipped` but keeps executing — it fails on any machine without `FA_IMPORT_E2E=1` + a real `~/.omp` store (verified: errors with `ForeignStoreAbsent`).
- ⚠️ Headless `fa import` routes its only output through `io.writeln`, which is **stderr** in headless mode — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts" is inverted at the bin boundary.
- ⚠️ `blob:sha256:<hash>` refs are interpolated into a filesystem path with no validation on `hash` — a crafted session line can make the importer read files outside the blob dir.

**Next Steps**:
1. Add the missing `foreign_session.dart` import to `bin/fah.dart` (or export `ImportLimits` from the import layer).
2. Fix the test-tier compile errors (move the getters out of `main()` / make them locals or top-level; align `run(...)` call sites with the helper signature; fix `bucket.path` vs returned `String`; import `ToolResultMessage`).
3. Guard the E2E test body so `markTestSkipped` is followed by `return` (or skip via `setUp`).
4. Route import output to `stdout` in the headless CLI path; validate the blob hash before building the path.
5. Optional: double-counted claude `tool_result` skips, and the SUGGESTION-level items in the inline threads.

{"content":"## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The architecture is sound (read-only adapters, pure mapper, injectable `ImportLimits`, zero provider wiring, trajectory-style CLI interception), and the lib layer analyzes clean — but this branch does not build or test as committed. Reviewed on a Linux runner with a working Dart SDK 3.13.5: `dart analyze` reports **47 errors in the new import files** (the other 79 analyzer errors are pre-existing `office_addin/` package issues untouched by this PR), and `dart test test/import ...` fails 5 ways: four test files fail to load (compile errors), and the machine-gated E2E test fails instead of skipping.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `bin/fah_import.dart` uses `ImportLimits` without a visible import — the whole `fa` CLI fails to compile.
- 🚨 `test/import_runner_test.dart` + `test/import_tui_test.dart` declare `String get ompRoot/ompBucket` **inside `void main()`** (local getters are invalid Dart — 41 cascading errors), plus positional-vs-named drift against the local `run` helper and `.path` on a `String` in `omp_adapter_test.dart` (helper returns the path, callers expect a `Directory`).
- 🚨 `import_mapper_test.dart` references `ToolResultMessage`, which lives in `lib/src/context.dart` and is not imported.
- 🚨 The E2E test calls `markTestSkipped` but keeps executing — it fails on any machine without `FA_IMPORT_E2E=1` + a real `~/.omp` store (verified: errors with `ForeignStoreAbsent`).
- ⚠️ Headless `fa import` routes its only output through `io.writeln`, which is **stderr** in headless mode — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts" is inverted at the bin boundary.
- ⚠️ `blob:sha256:<hash>` refs are interpolated into a filesystem path with no validation on `hash` — a crafted session line can make the importer read files outside the blob dir.

**Next Steps**:
1. Add the missing `foreign_session.dart` import to `bin/fah.dart` (or export `ImportLimits` from the import layer).
2. Fix the test-tier compile errors (move the getters out of `main()` / make them locals or top-level; align `run(...)` call sites with the helper signature; fix `bucket.path` vs returned `String`; import `ToolResultMessage`).
3. Guard the E2E test body so `markTestSkipped` is followed by `return` (or skip via `setUp`).
4. Route import output to `stdout` in the headless CLI path; validate the blob hash before building the path.
5. Optional: double-counted claude `tool_result` skips, and the SUGGESTION-level items in the inline threads.

🚨 **BLOCKING: `ImportLimits` is not visible in the `bin/fah.dart` library — the CLI does not compile**

`ImportLimits` is declared in `lib/src/import/foreign_session.dart`, but `bin/fah.dart` imports only `harness_adapter.dart` and `import_runner.dart`, and neither re-exports it. Since this file is `part of 'fah.dart'`, the name cannot resolve:

```
error - bin/fah_import.dart:33:19 - The name 'ImportLimits' isn't a class. - creation_with_non_type
```

Verified locally (`dart analyze bin/fah_import.dart`), so the `fa` binary itself fails to build even though the lib layer is clean. Fix — add the import in `bin/fah.dart`:

```dart
import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/import/foreign_session.dart';
```

(alongside the existing two import-layer imports), or add `export 'foreign_session.dart';` to `import_runner.dart`/`harness_adapter.dart`.

🚨 **BLOCKING: `String get ompRoot` / `String get ompBucket` are declared inside `void main()` — invalid Dart**

Local getters do not exist in Dart; getters must be top-level or class members. The parser rejects line 29 and everything after it cascades (the analyzer reports 36 errors in this file: `Expected to find ';'`, `The name 'get' is already defined`, `missing_function_parameters`, then type fallout like `ompRoot` resolving to `String Function()`).

```dart
void main() {
  ...
  String get ompRoot => '${home.path}/.omp/agent/sessions';   // ← invalid
  String get ompBucket => ...                                  // ← invalid
```

Fix: make them top-level getters (they reference `late` locals, so hoist the `late Directory home/project/...` declarations to top level too — the standard pattern in this repo's test files), or convert them to local functions/`final` locals computed after `setUp` runs. The same pattern breaks `test/import/import_tui_test.dart:26` (5 more errors).

{"content":"## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The architecture is sound (read-only adapters, pure mapper, injectable `ImportLimits`, zero provider wiring, trajectory-style CLI interception), and the lib layer analyzes clean — but this branch does not build or test as committed. Reviewed on a Linux runner with a working Dart SDK 3.13.5: `dart analyze` reports **47 errors in the new import files** (the other 79 analyzer errors are pre-existing `office_addin/` package issues untouched by this PR), and `dart test test/import ...` fails 5 ways: four test files fail to load (compile errors), and the machine-gated E2E test fails instead of skipping.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `bin/fah_import.dart` uses `ImportLimits` without a visible import — the whole `fa` CLI fails to compile.
- 🚨 `test/import_runner_test.dart` + `test/import_tui_test.dart` declare `String get ompRoot/ompBucket` **inside `void main()`** (local getters are invalid Dart — 41 cascading errors), plus positional-vs-named drift against the local `run` helper and `.path` on a `String` in `omp_adapter_test.dart` (helper returns the path, callers expect a `Directory`).
- 🚨 `import_mapper_test.dart` references `ToolResultMessage`, which lives in `lib/src/context.dart` and is not imported.
- 🚨 The E2E test calls `markTestSkipped` but keeps executing — it fails on any machine without `FA_IMPORT_E2E=1` + a real `~/.omp` store (verified: errors with `ForeignStoreAbsent`).
- ⚠️ Headless `fa import` routes its only output through `io.writeln`, which is **stderr** in headless mode — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts" is inverted at the bin boundary.
- ⚠️ `blob:sha256:<hash>` refs are interpolated into a filesystem path with no validation on `hash` — a crafted session line can make the importer read files outside the blob dir.

**Next Steps**:
1. Add the missing `foreign_session.dart` import to `bin/fah.dart` (or export `ImportLimits` from the import layer).
2. Fix the test-tier compile errors (move the getters out of `main()` / make them locals or top-level; align `run(...)` call sites with the helper signature; fix `bucket.path` vs returned `String`; import `ToolResultMessage`).
3. Guard the E2E test body so `markTestSkipped` is followed by `return` (or skip via `setUp`).
4. Route import output to `stdout` in the headless CLI path; validate the blob hash before building the path.
5. Optional: double-counted claude `tool_result` skips, and the SUGGESTION-level items in the inline threads.

{"content":"## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The architecture is sound (read-only adapters, pure mapper, injectable `ImportLimits`, zero provider wiring, trajectory-style CLI interception), and the lib layer analyzes clean — but this branch does not build or test as committed. Reviewed on a Linux runner with a working Dart SDK 3.13.5: `dart analyze` reports **47 errors in the new import files** (the other 79 analyzer errors are pre-existing `office_addin/` package issues untouched by this PR), and `dart test test/import ...` fails 5 ways: four test files fail to load (compile errors), and the machine-gated E2E test fails instead of skipping.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `bin/fah_import.dart` uses `ImportLimits` without a visible import — the whole `fa` CLI fails to compile.
- 🚨 `test/import_runner_test.dart` + `test/import_tui_test.dart` declare `String get ompRoot/ompBucket` **inside `void main()`** (local getters are invalid Dart — 41 cascading errors), plus positional-vs-named drift against the local `run` helper and `.path` on a `String` in `omp_adapter_test.dart` (helper returns the path, callers expect a `Directory`).
- 🚨 `import_mapper_test.dart` references `ToolResultMessage`, which lives in `lib/src/context.dart` and is not imported.
- 🚨 The E2E test calls `markTestSkipped` but keeps executing — it fails on any machine without `FA_IMPORT_E2E=1` + a real `~/.omp` store (verified: errors with `ForeignStoreAbsent`).
- ⚠️ Headless `fa import` routes its only output through `io.writeln`, which is **stderr** in headless mode — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts" is inverted at the bin boundary.
- ⚠️ `blob:sha256:<hash>` refs are interpolated into a filesystem path with no validation on `hash` — a crafted session line can make the importer read files outside the blob dir.

**Next Steps**:
1. Add the missing `foreign_session.dart` import to `bin/fah.dart` (or export `ImportLimits` from the import layer).
2. Fix the test-tier compile errors (move the getters out of `main()` / make them locals or top-level; align `run(...)` call sites with the helper signature; fix `bucket.path` vs returned `String`; import `ToolResultMessage`).
3. Guard the E2E test body so `markTestSkipped` is followed by `return` (or skip via `setUp`).
4. Route import output to `stdout` in the headless CLI path; validate the blob hash before building the path.
5. Optional: double-counted claude `tool_result` skips, and the SUGGESTION-level items in the inline threads.

🚨 **BLOCKING: `ToolResultMessage` is never imported in this test**

The type lives in `lib/src/context.dart` (`final class ToolResultMessage implements Message`); this file imports `src/types.dart`, which does not export it:


```dart
import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/context.dart';
```

🚨 **BLOCKING: `markTestSkipped` does not halt the test body — this test FAILS instead of skipping**

`package:test`'s `markTestSkipped` only records the skip state (test_api `Invoker.skip` sets `Result.skipped` and returns `void`); execution continues. The next statement is `adapter.discover(...)`, which throws `ForeignStoreAbsent` on any machine without a real `~/.omp` store — so the test errors and is reported as failed. Verified locally:

```
00:00 +7 -5: ... real omp store: discovery + full read of the newest session [E]
  no harness store at /home/runner/.omp/agent/sessions
```

Fix — return right after marking:

```dart
if (!e2eEnabled || !storeReady) {
  markTestSkipped('machine-gated: requires FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 and a real '
      '~/.omp/agent/sessions store');
  return;
}
```

(alternatively gate the whole body with `if (e2eEnabled && storeReady) { ... }`). As written, this is a permanent red test in every CI/dev environment.

{"content":"## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The architecture is sound (read-only adapters, pure mapper, injectable `ImportLimits`, zero provider wiring, trajectory-style CLI interception), and the lib layer analyzes clean — but this branch does not build or test as committed. Reviewed on a Linux runner with a working Dart SDK 3.13.5: `dart analyze` reports **47 errors in the new import files** (the other 79 analyzer errors are pre-existing `office_addin/` package issues untouched by this PR), and `dart test test/import ...` fails 5 ways: four test files fail to load (compile errors), and the machine-gated E2E test fails instead of skipping.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `bin/fah_import.dart` uses `ImportLimits` without a visible import — the whole `fa` CLI fails to compile.
- 🚨 `test/import_runner_test.dart` + `test/import_tui_test.dart` declare `String get ompRoot/ompBucket` **inside `void main()`** (local getters are invalid Dart — 41 cascading errors), plus positional-vs-named drift against the local `run` helper and `.path` on a `String` in `omp_adapter_test.dart` (helper returns the path, callers expect a `Directory`).
- 🚨 `import_mapper_test.dart` references `ToolResultMessage`, which lives in `lib/src/context.dart` and is not imported.
- 🚨 The E2E test calls `markTestSkipped` but keeps executing — it fails on any machine without `FA_IMPORT_E2E=1` + a real `~/.omp` store (verified: errors with `ForeignStoreAbsent`).
- ⚠️ Headless `fa import` routes its only output through `io.writeln`, which is **stderr** in headless mode — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts" is inverted at the bin boundary.
- ⚠️ `blob:sha256:<hash>` refs are interpolated into a filesystem path with no validation on `hash` — a crafted session line can make the importer read files outside the blob dir.

**Next Steps**:
1. Add the missing `foreign_session.dart` import to `bin/fah.dart` (or export `ImportLimits` from the import layer).
2. Fix the test-tier compile errors (move the getters out of `main()` / make them locals or top-level; align `run(...)` call sites with the helper signature; fix `bucket.path` vs returned `String`; import `ToolResultMessage`).
3. Guard the E2E test body so `markTestSkipped` is followed by `return` (or skip via `setUp`).
4. Route import output to `stdout` in the headless CLI path; validate the blob hash before building the path.
5. Optional: double-counted claude `tool_result` skips, and the SUGGESTION-level items in the inline threads.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: in headless mode `io.writeln` writes to stderr — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts only" is inverted at the bin boundary**

`_TerminalCliIO` (bin/fah_io.dart) implements the repo's CliIO contract: `write` is the primary stream (stdout), `writeln` is the diagnostics stream — and in headless mode it is wired to **stderr**:

```dart
void writeln(String text) =>
    headless ? stderr.writeln(text) : stdout.writeln(text);
```

`_runImportCommand` constructs `_TerminalCliIO(headless: true)` and passes `onLine: io.writeln`, so every `imported <id> → <faId> (n records)` / `skipped ...` line — the command's only product — lands on stderr and stdout stays empty. Scripts doing `fa import --all` and reading stdout get nothing.

The IT test titled "AC11: stdout carries ids/counts only" only inspects the runner's `lines` list via the `onLine` callback, so it cannot catch the bin wiring. Fix here:

```dart
onLine: (line) => io.write('$line\n'),
```

(or `stdout.writeln` directly, matching how the trajectory command emits).

{"content":"## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The architecture is sound (read-only adapters, pure mapper, injectable `ImportLimits`, zero provider wiring, trajectory-style CLI interception), and the lib layer analyzes clean — but this branch does not build or test as committed. Reviewed on a Linux runner with a working Dart SDK 3.13.5: `dart analyze` reports **47 errors in the new import files** (the other 79 analyzer errors are pre-existing `office_addin/` package issues untouched by this PR), and `dart test test/import ...` fails 5 ways: four test files fail to load (compile errors), and the machine-gated E2E test fails instead of skipping.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `bin/fah_import.dart` uses `ImportLimits` without a visible import — the whole `fa` CLI fails to compile.
- 🚨 `test/import_runner_test.dart` + `test/import_tui_test.dart` declare `String get ompRoot/ompBucket` **inside `void main()`** (local getters are invalid Dart — 41 cascading errors), plus positional-vs-named drift against the local `run` helper and `.path` on a `String` in `omp_adapter_test.dart` (helper returns the path, callers expect a `Directory`).
- 🚨 `import_mapper_test.dart` references `ToolResultMessage`, which lives in `lib/src/context.dart` and is not imported.
- 🚨 The E2E test calls `markTestSkipped` but keeps executing — it fails on any machine without `FA_IMPORT_E2E=1` + a real `~/.omp` store (verified: errors with `ForeignStoreAbsent`).
- ⚠️ Headless `fa import` routes its only output through `io.writeln`, which is **stderr** in headless mode — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts" is inverted at the bin boundary.
- ⚠️ `blob:sha256:<hash>` refs are interpolated into a filesystem path with no validation on `hash` — a crafted session line can make the importer read files outside the blob dir.

**Next Steps**:
1. Add the missing `foreign_session.dart` import to `bin/fah.dart` (or export `ImportLimits` from the import layer).
2. Fix the test-tier compile errors (move the getters out of `main()` / make them locals or top-level; align `run(...)` call sites with the helper signature; fix `bucket.path` vs returned `String`; import `ToolResultMessage`).
3. Guard the E2E test body so `markTestSkipped` is followed by `return` (or skip via `setUp`).
4. Route import output to `stdout` in the headless CLI path; validate the blob hash before building the path.
5. Optional: double-counted claude `tool_result` skips, and the SUGGESTION-level items in the inline threads.

{"content":"⚠️ **IMPORTANT: in headless mode `io.writeln` writes to stderr — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts only" is inverted at the bin boundary**

`_TerminalCliIO` (bin/fah_io.dart) implements the repo's CliIO contract: `write` is the primary stream (stdout), `writeln` is the diagnostics stream — and in headless mode it is wired to **stderr**:

```dart
void writeln(String text) =>
    headless ? stderr.writeln(text) : stdout.writeln(text);
```

`_runImportCommand` constructs `_TerminalCliIO(headless: true)` and passes `onLine: io.writeln`, so every `imported <id> → <faId> (n records)` / `skipped ...` line — the command's only product — lands on stderr and stdout stays empty. Scripts doing `fa import --all` and reading stdout get nothing.

The IT test titled "AC11: stdout carries ids/counts only" only inspects the runner's `lines` list via the `onLine` callback, so it cannot catch the bin wiring. Fix here:

```dart
onLine: (line) => io.write('$line\n'),
```

(or `stdout.writeln` directly, matching how the trajectory command emits).

{"content":"## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The architecture is sound (read-only adapters, pure mapper, injectable `ImportLimits`, zero provider wiring, trajectory-style CLI interception), and the lib layer analyzes clean — but this branch does not build or test as committed. Reviewed on a Linux runner with a working Dart SDK 3.13.5: `dart analyze` reports **47 errors in the new import files** (the other 79 analyzer errors are pre-existing `office_addin/` package issues untouched by this PR), and `dart test test/import ...` fails 5 ways: four test files fail to load (compile errors), and the machine-gated E2E test fails instead of skipping.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `bin/fah_import.dart` uses `ImportLimits` without a visible import — the whole `fa` CLI fails to compile.
- 🚨 `test/import_runner_test.dart` + `test/import_tui_test.dart` declare `String get ompRoot/ompBucket` **inside `void main()`** (local getters are invalid Dart — 41 cascading errors), plus positional-vs-named drift against the local `run` helper and `.path` on a `String` in `omp_adapter_test.dart` (helper returns the path, callers expect a `Directory`).
- 🚨 `import_mapper_test.dart` references `ToolResultMessage`, which lives in `lib/src/context.dart` and is not imported.
- 🚨 The E2E test calls `markTestSkipped` but keeps executing — it fails on any machine without `FA_IMPORT_E2E=1` + a real `~/.omp` store (verified: errors with `ForeignStoreAbsent`).
- ⚠️ Headless `fa import` routes its only output through `io.writeln`, which is **stderr** in headless mode — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts" is inverted at the bin boundary.
- ⚠️ `blob:sha256:<hash>` refs are interpolated into a filesystem path with no validation on `hash` — a crafted session line can make the importer read files outside the blob dir.

**Next Steps**:
1. Add the missing `foreign_session.dart` import to `bin/fah.dart` (or export `ImportLimits` from the import layer).
2. Fix the test-tier compile errors (move the getters out of `main()` / make them locals or top-level; align `run(...)` call sites with the helper signature; fix `bucket.path` vs returned `String`; import `ToolResultMessage`).
3. Guard the E2E test body so `markTestSkipped` is followed by `return` (or skip via `setUp`).
4. Route import output to `stdout` in the headless CLI path; validate the blob hash before building the path.
5. Optional: double-counted claude `tool_result` skips, and the SUGGESTION-level items in the inline threads.

{"content":"⚠️ **IMPORTANT: in headless mode `io.writeln` writes to stderr — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts only" is inverted at the bin boundary**

`_TerminalCliIO` (bin/fah_io.dart) implements the repo's CliIO contract: `write` is the primary stream (stdout), `writeln` is the diagnostics stream — and in headless mode it is wired to **stderr**:

```dart
void writeln(String text) =>
    headless ? stderr.writeln(text) : stdout.writeln(text);
```

`_runImportCommand` constructs `_TerminalCliIO(headless: true)` and passes `onLine: io.writeln`, so every `imported <id> → <faId> (n records)` / `skipped ...` line — the command's only product — lands on stderr and stdout stays empty. Scripts doing `fa import --all` and reading stdout get nothing.

The IT test titled "AC11: stdout carries ids/counts only" only inspects the runner's `lines` list via the `onLine` callback, so it cannot catch the bin wiring. Fix here:

```dart
onLine: (line) => io.write('$line\n'),
```

(or `stdout.writeln` directly, matching how the trajectory command emits).

💡 **SUGGESTION: the non-ranged fallback of `_readPrefix` reads the whole file with no size gate**

The ranged path bounds the header read to 4096 bytes and `scanForeignLines` enforces `maxFileBytes` before reading — but when `fs` is not a `RangedReadFileSystem` (e.g. `MemoryExecutionEnv`, the web shell), `fs.readTextFile(path)` pulls the **entire** file into memory during discovery, unbounded by `ImportLimits`. `LocalExecutionEnv` is ranged so the real CLI is unaffected, but the fallback should still consult `fileInfo(...).size` against `limits.maxFileBytes` (or stream lines and stop after the header) so the 512 MiB cap story holds on every backend.

💡 **SUGGESTION: `summary` is shadowed here — the pattern variable hides the `_importOne` parameter**

```dart
case PlannedCompaction(:final summary):
  await session.appendCompaction(
    summary: summary,
    ...
```

The `:final summary` pattern field shadows the enclosing `summary` parameter (`ForeignSessionSummary`) for the rest of the switch arm. It compiles (the PR calls this out), but a reader can no longer tell which `summary` an unqualified reference means — and a later edit that reaches for the outer `summary` inside this arm silently binds the wrong value. Rename one of them (e.g. `case PlannedCompaction(:final summary) => appendCompaction(summary: compactionSummary, ...)` via a local alias).

{"content":"## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The architecture is sound (read-only adapters, pure mapper, injectable `ImportLimits`, zero provider wiring, trajectory-style CLI interception), and the lib layer analyzes clean — but this branch does not build or test as committed. Reviewed on a Linux runner with a working Dart SDK 3.13.5: `dart analyze` reports **47 errors in the new import files** (the other 79 analyzer errors are pre-existing `office_addin/` package issues untouched by this PR), and `dart test test/import ...` fails 5 ways: four test files fail to load (compile errors), and the machine-gated E2E test fails instead of skipping.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `bin/fah_import.dart` uses `ImportLimits` without a visible import — the whole `fa` CLI fails to compile.
- 🚨 `test/import_runner_test.dart` + `test/import_tui_test.dart` declare `String get ompRoot/ompBucket` **inside `void main()`** (local getters are invalid Dart — 41 cascading errors), plus positional-vs-named drift against the local `run` helper and `.path` on a `String` in `omp_adapter_test.dart` (helper returns the path, callers expect a `Directory`).
- 🚨 `import_mapper_test.dart` references `ToolResultMessage`, which lives in `lib/src/context.dart` and is not imported.
- 🚨 The E2E test calls `markTestSkipped` but keeps executing — it fails on any machine without `FA_IMPORT_E2E=1` + a real `~/.omp` store (verified: errors with `ForeignStoreAbsent`).
- ⚠️ Headless `fa import` routes its only output through `io.writeln`, which is **stderr** in headless mode — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts" is inverted at the bin boundary.
- ⚠️ `blob:sha256:<hash>` refs are interpolated into a filesystem path with no validation on `hash` — a crafted session line can make the importer read files outside the blob dir.

**Next Steps**:
1. Add the missing `foreign_session.dart` import to `bin/fah.dart` (or export `ImportLimits` from the import layer).
2. Fix the test-tier compile errors (move the getters out of `main()` / make them locals or top-level; align `run(...)` call sites with the helper signature; fix `bucket.path` vs returned `String`; import `ToolResultMessage`).
3. Guard the E2E test body so `markTestSkipped` is followed by `return` (or skip via `setUp`).
4. Route import output to `stdout` in the headless CLI path; validate the blob hash before building the path.
5. Optional: double-counted claude `tool_result` skips, and the SUGGESTION-level items in the inline threads.

{"content":"⚠️ **IMPORTANT: in headless mode `io.writeln` writes to stderr — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts only" is inverted at the bin boundary**

`_TerminalCliIO` (bin/fah_io.dart) implements the repo's CliIO contract: `write` is the primary stream (stdout), `writeln` is the diagnostics stream — and in headless mode it is wired to **stderr**:

```dart
void writeln(String text) =>
    headless ? stderr.writeln(text) : stdout.writeln(text);
```

`_runImportCommand` constructs `_TerminalCliIO(headless: true)` and passes `onLine: io.writeln`, so every `imported <id> → <faId> (n records)` / `skipped ...` line — the command's only product — lands on stderr and stdout stays empty. Scripts doing `fa import --all` and reading stdout get nothing.

The IT test titled "AC11: stdout carries ids/counts only" only inspects the runner's `lines` list via the `onLine` callback, so it cannot catch the bin wiring. Fix here:

```dart
onLine: (line) => io.write('$line\n'),
```

(or `stdout.writeln` directly, matching how the trajectory command emits).

{"content":"## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The architecture is sound (read-only adapters, pure mapper, injectable `ImportLimits`, zero provider wiring, trajectory-style CLI interception), and the lib layer analyzes clean — but this branch does not build or test as committed. Reviewed on a Linux runner with a working Dart SDK 3.13.5: `dart analyze` reports **47 errors in the new import files** (the other 79 analyzer errors are pre-existing `office_addin/` package issues untouched by this PR), and `dart test test/import ...` fails 5 ways: four test files fail to load (compile errors), and the machine-gated E2E test fails instead of skipping.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `bin/fah_import.dart` uses `ImportLimits` without a visible import — the whole `fa` CLI fails to compile.
- 🚨 `test/import_runner_test.dart` + `test/import_tui_test.dart` declare `String get ompRoot/ompBucket` **inside `void main()`** (local getters are invalid Dart — 41 cascading errors), plus positional-vs-named drift against the local `run` helper and `.path` on a `String` in `omp_adapter_test.dart` (helper returns the path, callers expect a `Directory`).
- 🚨 `import_mapper_test.dart` references `ToolResultMessage`, which lives in `lib/src/context.dart` and is not imported.
- 🚨 The E2E test calls `markTestSkipped` but keeps executing — it fails on any machine without `FA_IMPORT_E2E=1` + a real `~/.omp` store (verified: errors with `ForeignStoreAbsent`).
- ⚠️ Headless `fa import` routes its only output through `io.writeln`, which is **stderr** in headless mode — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts" is inverted at the bin boundary.
- ⚠️ `blob:sha256:<hash>` refs are interpolated into a filesystem path with no validation on `hash` — a crafted session line can make the importer read files outside the blob dir.

**Next Steps**:
1. Add the missing `foreign_session.dart` import to `bin/fah.dart` (or export `ImportLimits` from the import layer).
2. Fix the test-tier compile errors (move the getters out of `main()` / make them locals or top-level; align `run(...)` call sites with the helper signature; fix `bucket.path` vs returned `String`; import `ToolResultMessage`).
3. Guard the E2E test body so `markTestSkipped` is followed by `return` (or skip via `setUp`).
4. Route import output to `stdout` in the headless CLI path; validate the blob hash before building the path.
5. Optional: double-counted claude `tool_result` skips, and the SUGGESTION-level items in the inline threads.

{"content":"⚠️ **IMPORTANT: in headless mode `io.writeln` writes to stderr — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts only" is inverted at the bin boundary**

`_TerminalCliIO` (bin/fah_io.dart) implements the repo's CliIO contract: `write` is the primary stream (stdout), `writeln` is the diagnostics stream — and in headless mode it is wired to **stderr**:

```dart
void writeln(String text) =>
    headless ? stderr.writeln(text) : stdout.writeln(text);
```

`_runImportCommand` constructs `_TerminalCliIO(headless: true)` and passes `onLine: io.writeln`, so every `imported <id> → <faId> (n records)` / `skipped ...` line — the command's only product — lands on stderr and stdout stays empty. Scripts doing `fa import --all` and reading stdout get nothing.

The IT test titled "AC11: stdout carries ids/counts only" only inspects the runner's `lines` list via the `onLine` callback, so it cannot catch the bin wiring. Fix here:

```dart
onLine: (line) => io.write('$line\n'),
```

(or `stdout.writeln` directly, matching how the trajectory command emits).

content.text:
Review complete. **Verdict: REQUEST_CHANGES** — 6 blocking, 3 important, 4 suggestions.

## What I did

Unlike the author's environment (Dart VM SIGKILLed on their Mac), this Linux runner has a working Dart SDK 3.13.5, so I ran the gates the PR description says are "the real gate":

- **`dart pub get`** — clean.
- **`dart analyze`** — lib layer is clean, but **48 errors in the new code**: `bin/fah.dart` doesn't compile, and 4 of the 5 new test files don't compile (the other 79 analyzer errors are pre-existing `office_addin/` package issues untouched by this PR).
- **`dart test test/import ...`** — 4 files fail to load; the machine-gated E2E test *fails* instead of skipping.

## Key findings

**Blocking:**
1. `bin/fah_import.dart:33` — `ImportLimits` isn't visible in the `bin/fah.dart` library (no import of `foreign_session.dart`, no re-export) → the whole `fa` CLI fails to build.
2. `test/import_runner_test.dart` / `import_tui_test.dart` — `String get ompRoot/ompBucket` declared **inside `void main()`** (local getters are invalid Dart; 41 cascading parse errors).
3. `import_runner_test.dart` — every `run(const ImportSelector.all())` call is positional while the helper declares `selector` named.
4. `omp_adapter_test.dart` — `writeBucket` returns a path `String`; 4 call sites use `bucket.path` on it.
5. `import_mapper_test.dart` — `ToolResultMessage` (lives in `lib/src/context.dart`) never imported.
6. E2E test — `markTestSkipped` only marks state, it doesn't halt execution, so the test proceeds and dies with `ForeignStoreAbsent` on every normal machine.

**Important:** headless `fa import` emits its only output via `io.writeln`, which is **stderr** in headless mode — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts" is inverted and untested at the bin boundary; the `blob:sha256:<hash>` ref is interpolated into a path with no hash validation (path traversal); claude `tool_result` blocks are lifted into records *and* counted as skipped blocks, corrupting `skippedBlocks`.

**Positives:** the architecture matches repo patterns well (read-only adapters, pure mapper, injectable `ImportLimits`, trajectory-style CLI interception with zero provider wiring, honest disclosure). The lib code itself is analyzer-clean.

All artifacts written: `outputs/pr_review.json`, `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, and `outputs/pr_review_comments/comment01..13.md` with diff-anchored lines.
